MILP_word_grammar.scope: The exact finite cost model is distinct from the physical TM state objective; no global TM lower bound.

limitations: Search proposal slots may repeat grammars or be no-ops.
Scanner scores alone do not establish physical correctness.
The unsuccessful local rules exclude longer detours, larger windows, multiple rewritten helper controls, and global tape recodings.
No search result establishes a lower bound for arbitrary PA-consistency machines.
